releaseNotes: Fix (5": jc8048w550c/elecrow-crowpanel-5-0, and 7": esp32-8048s070c): Fan Art and Screenshot cards -- full-bleed photographic images, larger than any card type these panels previously received -- could silently exceed the firmware's incoming-frame size limit, which the firmware rejected with no reply and no error. The rejected image's own bytes then got misread as serial commands, flooding the device with spurious identification-probe replies for several seconds and leaving touch completely unresponsive during that window. Raised the frame size limit (and the matching serial receive buffer) on all three boards; pixelweb also now caps how large a card it will ever send to a given panel, so this can't recur even if a future card type is bigger still.

Fix (5" / jc8048w550c only): touch stopped responding for this board's specific hardware revision under certain conditions -- root cause was the touch controller's interrupt pin being configured to a GPIO that isn't actually wired to anything on this board's real schematic, corrected to match.
WIP -- not yet confirmed working, do not ship: investigating random noise on the trailing few columns of every line on 5" (RGB-parallel) panels. Root cause still open.
Fix: 5" boot splash now defaults to the correct (flipped) orientation for this board's standard mounting, instead of showing upside-down until Companion connects and applies its own saved rotation.
